messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Disconnecting from Server, but log only shows warnings
parts:
Aaron,
What is the URL to your application?  Also did you happen to take a look at the Javascript console to see if there is any other error being thrown?

On Tue, Mar 15, 2016 at 1:30 PM, Aaron Kaufman <internetp...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,

I have an observeEvent() call which produces a warning when I run it locally, but it doesn't interfere with the operation of the application. I've successfully deployed my application, and it initializes fine (I think). However, when I test the application on the shinyapps server, I get a "Disconnected from server" error, and when I check the logs, the only anomaly is the warning: 

"Warning: Unhandled error in observer: replacement has length zero
observeEvent(input$Click.Counter)"

Any advice? Is it the warning that is causing the disconnection, or might it be something else?

--
